text.tspan: Child-Sum TreeLSTM / per-child forgetting | Operators & tensor flow
One nonleaf node / I12,H16,K3 / child-sum gates + per-child forget / read bottom to top
K=3 children; child_h/child_c:[3,16]; shared node gates and c,h:[1,16].
Summation uses dim0,keepdim=True; all child rows reuse the same learned four Linear families.
The selected actual method returns(c,h); recursive traversal is outside the diagram boundary.
Reviewed static source + selected profile. Repeated groups are templates; shapes are not runtime observations.
E### = source span; dashed = side / shape dependencies; fork/join roles are typed in IR; no implicit sum.
Repeated colors encode operation roles. Shared weights and independent instances are recorded in semantic_ir.json.
